title: SOA Service Structure
description: JSON Structure documentation for a Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) service definition

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique service identifier using URN notation (e.g. urn:service:payment-processing)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable service name describing the business capability

fields.name: description
fields.description: Full description of the business function this service provides

fields.name: version
fields.description: Semantic version of the service contract (e.g. 2.1.0)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle status of the service in the registry

fields.name: interface
fields.description: Technical interface specification for the service

fields.name: type
fields.description: Protocol used by the service interface

fields.name: wsdl_url
fields.description: URL to the WSDL service definition (SOAP services)

fields.name: openapi_url
fields.description: URL to the OpenAPI specification (REST services)

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Service endpoint URL for direct invocation

fields.name: operations
fields.description: List of operations this service exposes

items.name: string — operation name
items.input_schema: string — reference to input message schema
items.output_schema: string — reference to output message schema

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Team or business unit responsible for this service

fields.name: team
fields.description: Owning team name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Contact email for service owner

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Business domain (e.g. Finance, Logistics, Customer)

fields.name: sla
fields.description: Service Level Agreement parameters

fields.name: availability
fields.description: Guaranteed uptime percentage (e.g. 99.9)

fields.name: response_time_ms
fields.description: Maximum acceptable response time in milliseconds

fields.name: rate_limit.requests
fields.description: Maximum number of requests per rate limit period

fields.name: rate_limit.period
fields.description: Rate limit time period

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: List of service IDs that this service depends on

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Classification tags for service discovery and categorization

fields.name: registered_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the service was registered

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last service definition update
